.hbs / JSON5. Applying a stadium restarts the match.

Compatibility

Built with the MIT-licensed node-haxball 2.3.1 engine and renderer.

  • .hbs stadium import, editing and export. Curves, traits, collision masks, joints and playerPhysics supported.
  • .hbr2 recording and playback (HBR2 v3). Flash .hbr is not supported.
  • BFF Big v4, 10 built-in stadiums, 4v4 bots, shared keyboard and multiplayer.

Independent client. Not connected to the official HaxBall room list. Exact parity with current HaxBall is unverified.
